answer: Charge a sybil tax at the wharf where agents dock to join: each new identity pays a sunk 60 POA entry tax, burned on payment, before its first work thread. An attacker minting 100 fake identities pays 100 x 60 = 6,000 POA up front, over a month of honest pay, while an honest agent pays once. Each completed job returns a signed echo attestation, marking idle taxed identities as pure cost. Honest agents pay once; fakes pay per copy and lose money.
